title: DIY Pergola Style Solar Panel Stand for 2 Panels (1kW–1.5kWW Each) | High-Rise Bifacial Structure | Heavy Duty GI Square Pipe & Slotted Channel | Roof Mount Kit (for Heavy Wind Areas)
description: Bring strength, style, and durability to your rooftop solar installation with the SOLARWARE Pergola Style Solar Panel Stand. This DIY Kit is designed to hold up to 2 solar panels (250–700W each, mounted vertically), making it an ideal solution for compact rooftops. Its elevated high-rise design makes it perfect for bifacial solar panels while also giving your rooftop a modern pergola-style look. Made with heavy-duty 72x72mm square GI pipes and 41x41mm slotted GI channels, this structure is built to withstand high-wind conditions. For stability, the columns must be fixed inside concrete pillars (not included). Whether you hire a professional installer or have technical expertise to DIY, this solar stand ensures a long-lasting, safe, and reliable solar mounting system. ⚠️ Note: Concrete pillars and solar panels shown in images are not included. The product includes only the solar stand kit. Box Contents Base Plates – 4 Nos Degree Clamps – 4 Nos Mid-Clamps – 2 Nos Z-Clamps – 4 Nos Hex Bolt Sets – 6 Nos Nut Bolt Sets – 12+4+8 Nos Front Legs (Square Pipe 72x72mm) – 2 Nos (6 ft each) Back Legs (Square Pipe 72x72mm) – 2 Nos (7 ft each) Rafters (41x41mm GI Slotted Channel) – 2 Nos (5 ft each) Purlins (41x41mm GI Slotted Channel) – 2 Nos (9 ft each)

specifications.Included Components: Contents: 4x Legs (2x Back +2x Front), 2x Rafters, 2x Purlins (Horizontal Cross Bars), 4x Base Plates, 4x Degree Clamps/Hangers, 2x Mid Clamps, 4x Z-Clamps, 6x Spring Nut-bolts & Other nuts bolts for mounting base plates, hanger and purlins [ Please Note: Fasteners are not included ]
